scope: Five-page supplied main independently source-audited with accepted R2 corrections. SI/cited full sources unreviewed. One synthesis route; iodide assay is a separate downstream property context.

bibliographic_scope.title: Determination of Iodide via Direct Fluorescence Quenching at Nitrogen-Doped Carbon Quantum Dot Fluorophores
bibliographic_scope.authors: Haimin Zhang; Yibing Li; Xiaolu Liu; Porun Liu; Yun Wang; Taicheng An; Huagui Yang; Dengwei Jing; Huijun Zhao

preparation_details.route: One-pot hydrothermal preparation of N-CQDs from dried monkey grass in Milli-Q water.
preparation_details.charge: 5.0 g dried grass and 60 mL water; printed resistivity 18 MΩ without length-normalized unit.
preparation_details.workup: 0.2 μm cellulose-membrane filtration; source names 4500 and 12000 rpm for 10 min without resolving sequence, per-speed duration, or retained fraction.
preparation_details.yield: As-synthesized concentration ~19 mg/mL. Mass yield can reach 22.8%; no illustrated-batch yield/denominator is specified.
preparation_details.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2, Synthesis of N-CQDs.

structural_scope.composition: N-CQDs; no unique stoichiometric formula or atom-resolved composition.
structural_scope.morphology: TEM 1–4 nm; histogram approximately 55% near 2 nm. No quantified shape descriptor.
structural_scope.local_order: HRTEM approximately 0.32 nm fringe assigned by authors as graphitic-carbon <002>-consistent.
structural_scope.limits: No complete phase model, unit-cell parameters, atomic coordinates, or CIF in the reviewed main. SI-referenced XRD details are not imported.
structural_scope.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2, Results and Discussion; Figure 1.

characterization_context.surface: FTIR/XPS supports O/N-containing groups; zeta potential +30.2 mV. Exact finer assignments/medium are not added beyond main.
characterization_context.photoluminescence: Emission near 435 nm under 360 nm excitation.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2, Results and Discussion.

iodide_assay_context.scope: Downstream analytical use of an aliquot; not synthesis or extra pair.
iodide_assay_context.conditions: 100-fold diluted N-CQD solution in 0.2 M PBS, pH 7.0; excitation 360 nm; 1 h at room temperature.
iodide_assay_context.outcomes: Calibration/detection-limit outcomes are in the canonical record and Figure 4; Table 1 recovery data remain in the source image rather than individual rows.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2, Detection of Iodide.

source_interpretation.topic: Synthesis route and assay scope remain distinct.
source_interpretation.text: One hydrothermal treatment produces one reported N-CQD population. Dilution, PBS, iodide concentrations, and assay time describe downstream measurement, not extra synthesis recipes.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2, synthesis and iodide-detection methods; pp. 3–4, Figures 3–4 and Table 1.

source_interpretation.topic: Local fringe is not a full crystal model.
source_interpretation.text: The local HRTEM spacing supports only the author-assigned fringe interpretation; it does not supply a unit cell or coordinates.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2, Figure 1 and caption.

limitations: No molecular graphs are assigned to heterogeneous biomass, PBS, or unspecified iodide salt.
Publisher permission status for source figure display is unverified.
